title: Chapter 278: Another Spin at the Wheel
html:
“We found Xiao Jia. He’s unconscious, but physically unharmed.” Lee Zheng paused. “Chen Ge, however, seems to be having some trouble.”

“Xiao Chen is injured? Where are you? I’ll be there in a minute!” Captain Yan’s voice crackled over the walkie-talkie.

“No, he isn’t hurt, but he may have suffered severe psychological trauma. When we received his distress call, he was alone on the twenty-third floor with four escaped mental patients. He must have been through something terrible.” Lee Zheng looked at Chen Ge, who sat rigid on the stairs, and unease tightened his chest.

He had initially disliked Chen Ge, especially after their encounter in the interrogation room, where he had mistaken the man’s composure for arrogance. Yet the moment he heard Chen Ge’s cry for help, he had set aside his prejudice and led his team to the rescue. Even then, they had arrived one step too late.

As leader of the city police station’s investigative team, Lee Zheng knew how rarely victims survived such attacks. Physical wounds might heal with time, but psychological scars could last forever.

“If only we’d arrived sooner.” He wanted to comfort Chen Ge but could not find the words.

Chen Ge sat on the stairs between the twenty-second and twenty-third floors. He had been staring at his shadow for nearly ten minutes, and he had noticed something terrifying.

His shadow was not changing back!

Whenever the light struck him, he could see two shadows overlapping.

Something has changed within Zhang Ya. Previously she was hiding inside my shadow, but now she wants to morph into my shadow!

Chen Ge recalled Zhang Ya’s peculiar reaction upon seeing the wooden box.

The black bloodstain inside the box must have been extremely important to her. Black blood and a Red Specter… Is there a connection between them? Has absorbing it allowed her power to break through another limit?

The more he considered it, the more confused he became. He studied his shadow and watched Zhang Ya’s silhouette gradually replace his own. It seemed she intended to follow him forever, until he no longer cast a shadow at all.

His fingers brushed the wooden box against his chest. Truthfully, this was the first time a girl had given him a present. Everything about it was wrong, yet the gesture still felt strangely pleasant.

This is such a weird feeling.

Whatever happened to Zhang Ya in the future, one thing was certain—he would never speak ill of her again.

There shouldn’t be any immediate danger. After Zhang Ya swallowed the hospital director last time, she slept for several days, and I had to summon her to wake her. This time, she consumed two complete Red Specters, two blood faces, one thin monster, and that mysterious black blood. After a feast like that, she’ll probably be dormant for quite a while.

Zhang Ya was Chen Ge’s greatest fighting force. With her help, he had defeated the Ghost Stories Society; without her, he could not have handled even one Red Specter.

The man with the ruined face, the couple, and Manager Huang—with those four gone, the society has only three members left.

Chen Ge’s expression remained calm, betraying none of his thoughts.

The remaining three are the chairperson, No. 10, and Wu Fei. I still can’t confirm their identities, but one thing is certain: all three are exceptionally dangerous and cunning.

The society sent an entire team after me and still failed. They probably won’t make another move for a while.

Zhang Ya remained dormant. Though Chen Ge could not escape her ‘love,’ he had undeniably entered a period of vulnerability. If the society sent another two Red Specters, they could flatten his Haunted House.

For the first time, Chen Ge found himself missing Zhang Ya. Without her, he felt painfully exposed. Visitor numbers have been rising, and the Haunted House has accumulated plenty of screams. Perhaps it’s time to spin the wheel again.

Chen Ge did not want to use the Wheel of Misfortune, but he could think of no faster way to increase his strength. He needed more allies.

That black blood is mysterious. By the time Zhang Ya awakens, she may have advanced to an entirely new level.

Something even more terrifying than a Red Specter… The thought alone made Chen Ge shudder. Gripping the railing, he struggled to his feet. Dust covered his clothes, scratches lined his arms, and he looked ready to collapse at any moment.

“Careful.” Lee Zheng had remained beside him and immediately reached out to help.

“I’m fine. Please help me find Xiao Gu and Uncle Wong. I can take care of myself.” Chen Ge did not understand why Lee Zheng’s attitude had changed so abruptly. He suspected the officer had misunderstood something, but he was in no mood to explain.

The two returned to the twenty-third floor. Zhang Ya had devoured every monster, leaving the Society members unconscious and their minds severely damaged. The most frightening-looking man lay in the middle of the corridor like an empty shell, eyes open but utterly devoid of life.

Lee Zheng frowned at the scene as a strange thought surfaced.Why do these people look like the real victims?

No one knew what had truly happened on the twenty-third floor. The sole witness claimed that he had tripped on the stairs and hit his head; all he remembered was being chased.

When Lee Zheng opened Room 3239, the metallic scent of blood reached him. He rushed into the bathroom and found a family of three unconscious in a pool of their own blood, their wrists slit as though for some bloodletting ritual.

“They’re still breathing! Get in here and help—call an ambulance!”

Team 2 had already arrived, and its officers carried the real victims from the room. Unable to help, Chen Ge stood in a corner and quietly examined the strange symbol painted on the wall.

Drawn in fresh blood, it resembled some kind of written character. As Chen Ge approached, the ghosts he carried began to shudder.

Words capable of frightening Specters? It appears the Ghost Stories Society really does possess some power.

He was grateful he had not entered this room earlier. After studying the symbol for several minutes, he took out his phone and photographed it.

Deprived of fresh blood, the symbol slowly faded from the wall and lost its power.

After leaving Room 3239, Chen Ge and Lee Zheng entered the apartment opposite it.

The sight inside was chilling. Three nooses swayed in the center of the living room. The unconscious Uncle Wong and Xiao Gu lay beneath the first two; the third appeared to have been prepared for Chen Ge.

Three nooses, a family of three, and three remaining members. They certainly seem fond of the number three.
